correctness.rationale: The complete prime-two valuation-shell decomposition follows from the odd-power automorphism of units. Pair valuation cases are exhaustive, including zeros. The sharp maximum is bounded by |B| and attained by the valuation-d translation that embeds the smaller exponent image; the exact k=e+1 failure at zero follows from set inclusion of shells. Odd-target minimum follows from a strict upper bound on the two even-image sizes. A standalone enumerator checked 14,637 target, extremum and count assertions; finite tests do not replace the universal proof.

General transform identities could encode it indirectly; treated as a residual risk.

value.rationale: This determines all additive cross-correlations and the exact mixed energy for two natural and genuinely different dyadic power-value sets. The sharp phase transition at depth e+1, where zero loses maximality while nonzero valuation-d targets remain optimal, is an exact arithmetic embedding/translation phenomenon not visible from either individual set size or from usual root-weighted modular Waring counts. The complete target valuation law makes a natural invariant available without exponential enumeration; the work does not rely on claimed downstream theorems.
